description: Container demurrage or detention calculator: from the start date (discharge or gate-out), end date (gate-out or empty return), free days and the carrier's tiered daily rates you supply (e.g. 1-4:75,5-8:150,9+:250), returns chargeable days, the day-by-day tier split and the total per container and for all containers. Counts calendar days, start day included unless you say otherwise. Carrier tariffs are not looked up. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

countStartDay.description: true (default) counts the start date as day 1; false starts on the next day

currency.description: Currency label for the output, default USD

end.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD: gate-out full (demurrage) or empty return (detention) (required)

rates.description: Tiers after free time, 'from-to:rate' comma separated, last open-ended with '+', e.g. 1-4:75,5-8:150,9+:250 (required)

start.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD: discharge (demurrage) or gate-out full (detention) (required)

name: logistics_demurrage_detention
title: Logistics Demurrage Detention
